section_header: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch)
title: AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Overdrive Input Shaft and Clutch) AT-59

content.description: Hand installing thinner snap ring into overdrive clutch drum groove using fingers

content.text: 10. INSTALL THINNER SNAP RING IN OVERDRIVE CLUTCH DRUM

items: (a) Remove the overdrive clutch outer snap ring and hub to allow installation of the thinner snap ring.
(b) Compress and lower the snap ring into the groove by hand. Check that the ends of the snap ring are not aligned with one of the cutouts.

content.description: Hand installing hub and outer snap ring into overdrive clutch drum

content.text: 11. INSTALL HUB AND OUTER SNAP RING
Check that the ends of the snap ring are not aligned with one of the cutouts.

content.description: Hands meshing overdrive clutch drum hub with planetary gear disc, showing twisting and jiggling motion

content.text: 12. ASSEMBLE OVERDRIVE CLUTCH DRUM AND OVERDRIVE PLANETARY GEAR
Mesh the hub with the disc, twisting and jiggling the hub as required.

content.description: Hand checking one-way clutch operation by turning input shaft, showing Free (clockwise) and Lock (counterclockwise) directions

content.text: Hold the clutch drum and turn the input shaft. The input shaft should turn freely clockwise and should lock counterclockwise.
14. KEEP THRUST WASHER, THRUST BEARINGS AND RACE TOGETHER
